From the AI After 40 Studio

A Calm Morning, Planned With AI: Episode 40 Is Fresh From the Studio

Renee and Marcus slow the morning down in “A Calm Morning Routine, Planned With AI” — and tomorrow, the pair plan a whole week of suppers the same gentle way.

By the Gazette Staff · AI After 40 Desk

The fortieth episode of AI After 40 is fresh from the studio, and it begins the day the way every good day deserves to begin: calmly. In “A Calm Morning Routine, Planned With AI,” hosts Renee and Marcus walk listeners through a morning that was planned the night before — with a little help from AI — so the coffee, the quiet, and the getting-ready all happen in their proper order, with no rushing and no scrambling.

It is the show’s promise kept once again: plain talk, real life, and technology that serves the person using it. The episode runs a tidy three minutes and fifty-three seconds — just long enough to hear the whole routine while your own morning gets underway.

And the planning does not stop at breakfast. Tomorrow’s episode turns the same idea toward the kitchen table, as Renee and Marcus plan a whole week of suppers with AI — one list, one trip, and a week of evenings with the hardest question already answered.
